summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 17 June 2026 disclosing an initial notification of PDMR transactions under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation. CEO of Commercial Institutional, Robert Begbie, sold 150,000 ordinary shares at £6.3281 per share on the London Stock Exchange. The filing does not indicate any corporate event, change in control, or special situation beyond a routine insider transaction. As such, this is not a special-situation filing.
